entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 6077185317188247936: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 3.3231 +/- 0.0194 mas (same row, RUWE 1.24): 300.92 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -1.377, 3.976 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 1.627 +/- 0.062 solar radii from Addison et al. 2016, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-87 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016ApJ...823...29A/abstract). Mass 1.204 +/- 0.093 solar masses from Addison et al. 2016, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-87 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016ApJ...823...29A/abstract). Temperature 6450 +/- 120 K from Addison et al. 2016, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-87 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 6,450 K, because a companion 8.1 arcsec away gives 12% of the light (WDS 12213-5250, Mason et al. 2001) and blends into its measured spectra and catalogue colors, so the color is taken from its own temperature, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #fff8fd. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: skipped; gaia-xp: skipped; pulkovo: skipped; kiehling: skipped; kharitonov: skipped; burnashev: skipped; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 6,450 K and log g 4.1 (u1 0.355, u2 0.312): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
